literature_notes: The single ledger entry (L1) describes a GPR97/ADGRG3 CTF-only chimeric construct in which ADGRG3 residues 1–244 (the entire N-terminal fragment) are wholesale REPLACED by P2Y12 residues 1–34, and the HA epitope tag (positions 2–10) resides within the P2Y12 portion of that chimera — not within ADGRG3's own sequence. This is not a tag inserted into ADGRG3; it is a domain-swap experiment in which the NTF is deleted and a heterologous peptide carrying an HA tag is substituted. No specific ADGRG3 residue is named as a tag-insertion junction, and the HA sequence is never placed inside ADGRG3's polypeptide chain. The construct is full-length and membrane-anchored, and the HA is extracellular, but those facts do not convert a domain-replacement into a tag-insertion precedent for ADGRG3. The rules require that every site be grounded in a ledger line reporting an insertion tolerated at the site itself or in the same loop/domain of this protein; L1 does not meet that bar for any ADGRG3 residue. Accordingly, zero sites are reported.
